Protein Food

Rack of Lamb

About This Entry

Rack of lamb is the rib section frenched for presentation — tender, mild, and classic for fine dining. Herb crusts and mustard pan sauces pair with Pinot Noir, Syrah, and medium-bodied reds with spice-friendly fruit.

Beginner Guide

A full rack has eight ribs; 'frenched' means bones are scraped clean. Roast whole or slice into individual rib chops after cooking.

Wine Pairing Explanation

FAQ

What is Rack of Lamb?
A full rack has eight ribs; 'frenched' means bones are scraped clean.
How should Rack of Lamb be cooked for best results?
Match cooking method to cut — quick heat for tender muscles, slow moist heat for collagen-rich cuts. Rest roasts before slicing.
